Lightning Velo Saturday Ride

Long Beach, CA · East Long Beach · Road

Beginner friendly

Lightning Velo Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Long Beach, CA. It rolls saturdays and Sundays at 8:00 am from Marina Dr parking lot (temporary start during Studebaker Rd construction). Pace: a 23+ mph, B 19–22 (no drop), C 15–18 (no drop), D 10–15 developmental.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a 23+ mph, B 19–22 (no drop), C 15–18 (no drop), D 10–15 developmental. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @lightningvelolb the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Lightning Velo Saturday Ride group ride

Road club with four groups rolling every Saturday and Sunday morning. B and C groups are no-drop double pacelines; the D group is for newer road riders and covers skills and rules of the road. Rides end at a coffee shop in Seal Beach.
